source_caption_text:
Clavicular, whose real name is Braden Peters, 20, has been charged in Massachusetts in a case involving allegations that he raped and provided alcohol to a 16-year-old.

IMPORTANT CONTEXT: This is not simply a case of “she was 16, therefore it was rape.” The age of consent in Massachusetts is 16. The criminal allegations instead center on alcohol, alleged incapacity to consent, rape, and furnishing alcohol to a minor.

Peters is also facing a SEPARATE civil lawsuit filed in Miami in April 2026. In that lawsuit, a woman alleges she was 16 when Peters had sex with her while she was unable to consent and later injected her during a livestream.

These are TWO DIFFERENT MATTERS:

Massachusetts = CRIMINAL CASE
Miami = CIVIL LAWSUIT

The allegations have not been proven simply by being charged or alleged in a lawsuit.
